key.name: host
key.description: E.g. 192.168.1.1 or router.lan – HTTPS is always used (http:// only for localhost).

key.name: cert-fingerprint
key.summary: Pinned SHA-256 fingerprint of the router certificate
key.description: Set in the preferences after confirmation (“Test”). Only needed for certificates the system does not trust (self-signed).

key.name: password-serial
key.summary: Counter the preferences increase after saving the password
key.description: The keyring does not signal changes – this makes the extension restart polling.

key.name: allow-sim-switch
key.summary: Offer SIM actions in the menu (switch SIM, default SIM, reset data limit)
key.description: Requires a RutOS user with write access to Network → Mobile.

key.name: allow-reboot
key.description: Requires a RutOS user with write access to System → Administration.

key.name: hidden-sim-slots
key.summary: SIM slots not offered in the switch menu
key.description: E.g. empty slots – the API does not report whether a slot is occupied.

key.name: data-limit-warning
key.summary: Data limit warning threshold in percent (0 = only when the limit is used up)

key.name: sim-operators
key.description: Key “slot/eSIM profile” – the API only reports the operator of the active SIM.

key.name: show-net-type
key.summary: Show network type in the panel

key.name: show-signal
key.summary: Show signal value in the panel

key.name: signal-metric
key.summary: Signal value for the panel label
